technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with early reversal signals present, but price structure remains bearish with no moving average support and weak money flow—high false-signal risk in downtrend.

fundamental.summary: WY shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 37 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear market conditions present contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is stale (323+ days old) and neutral, with no recent insider conviction signals.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (381.4), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, with earnings event in 37 days adding execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold RSI(9) with StochRSI crossup and Awesome Oscillator twin peaks signal early reversal potential in fear-driven market conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages with negative money flow, no trend confirmation, macro headwinds at crisis levels (VIX 381.4), and earnings risk in 37 days—oversold bounces in downtrends carry high false-signal probability.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold RSI(9) with StochRSI crossup presents early reversal signal, and fear-zone sentiment offers contrarian opportunity. However, price remains structurally trapped below all major moving averages with negative money flow and zero smart money conviction, making this a high-probability false-signal bounce in an active downtrend.
decision.primary_risk: VIX at crisis levels (381.4) combined with earnings event in 37 days creates execution risk; oversold bounces in macro downtrends typically fail without institutional accumulation or trend confirmation.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical shows early reversal signals but fundamental, risk, and debate agents heavily weight macro headwinds and structural weakness; sentiment alone cannot overcome bearish price structure and zero smart money alignment.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 20 Real Estate positions with existing WY exposure; adding to concentration in low-conviction setup during sector saturation and macro crisis is imprudent.
